format: HTML with embedded Polymer element and JavaScript
description: This file defines a Polymer web component 'td-item' for a To-Do List item, including its template, behaviors, and associated JavaScript logic for interaction.

classes.name: td-item
classes.description: A custom Polymer element representing a to-do list item, handling editing, completion status, and deletion.

methods.name: setHostClass
methods.description: Sets CSS classes 'completed' and 'editing' based on item status.

methods.name: _onBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event to commit changes and exit editing mode.

methods.name: _editAction
methods.description: Enters editing mode, initializes the input value, and focuses the input field.

methods.name: _commitAction
methods.description: Commits the edit, updates the item title, and deletes if empty.

methods.name: _cancelAction
methods.description: Cancels editing mode without saving changes.

methods.name: _destroyAction
methods.description: Fires an event to delete the current item.
